title: एकाशीतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: With Arjuna at Jayadratha, Drona fights the Panchalas and Kauravas, and Bhima faces the Kauravas, while the day wears on. Sahadeva and Yudhishthira are engaged and the king is forced to withdraw.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನ ಜಯದ್ರಥನ ಬಳಿ ಹೋದಂತೆ ದ್ರೋಣ ಪಾಂಚಾಲ, ಕೌರವರೊಡನೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಮ ಕೌರವರನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಹದೇವ, ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿ ರಾಜ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन के जयद्रथ के निकट पहुँचने पर द्रोण पाञ्चालों और कौरवों से लड़ते हैं, और भीम कौरवों का सामना करते हैं। सहदेव और युधिष्ठिर भी उलझते हैं और राजा को हटना पड़ता है।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు జయద్రథుని వద్దకు చేరగా ద్రోణుడు పాంచాల, కౌరవులతో పోరాడతాడు; భీముడు కౌరవులను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు. సహదేవుడు, యుధిష్ఠిరుడు పోరులో చిక్కుకుంటారు, రాజు వెనక్కి తగ్గవలసి వస్తుంది.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் ஜயத்ரதனை நெருங்க, த்ரோணர் பாஞ்சாலரோடும் கௌரவரோடும் போரிடுகிறார்; பீமன் கௌரவரை எதிர்க்கிறான். சகதேவனும் யுதிஷ்டிரரும் போரில் சிக்க, மன்னர் பின்வாங்க நேர்கிறது.
summary.ml: അർജുനൻ ജയദ്രഥന്റെ അടുത്തായിരിക്കെ ദ്രോണർ പാഞ്ചാലരോടും കൗരവരോടും പൊരുതുന്നു; ഭീമൻ കൗരവരെ നേരിടുന്നു, ദിവസം കടന്നുപോകുന്നു. സഹദേവനും യുധിഷ്ഠിരനും പൊരുതുന്നു; രാജാവിന് പിന്തിരിയേണ്ടിവരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.81; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
अर्जुने सैन्धवं प्राप्ते भारद्वाजेन संवृताः ।
पाञ्चालाः कुरुभिः सार्धं किमकुर्वत संजय ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, when Arjuna had reached the Saindhava, what did the Panchalas, surrounded by Bharadvaja's son, do together with the Kurus?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अपराह्णे महाराज संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे ।
पाञ्चालानां कुरूणां च द्रोणे द्यूतमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: In the afternoon, great king, in that hair-raising battle, the gamble between the Panchalas and the Kurus centred on Drona.

verses.text:
पाञ्चाला हि जिघांसन्तो द्रोणं संहृष्टचेतसः ।
अभ्यवर्षन्त गर्जन्तः शरवर्षाणि मारिष ॥

meaning.en: The Panchalas, eager to kill Drona, with glad hearts, roared and rained showers of arrows on him, my lord.

verses.text:
ततः सुतुमुलस्तेषां संग्रामोऽवर्तताद्भुतः ।
पाञ्चालानां कुरूणां च घोरो देवासुरोपमः ॥

meaning.en: Then a most tumultuous and wondrous battle began between the Panchalas and the Kurus, terrible, like that of gods and asuras.

verses.text:
सर्वे द्रोणरथं प्राप्य पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह ।
तदनीकं बिभित्सन्तो महास्त्राणि व्यदर्शयन् ॥

meaning.en: All the Panchalas with the Pandavas, coming up to Drona's chariot and wishing to break his division, displayed their great weapons.

verses.text:
द्रोणस्य रथपर्यन्तं रथिनो रथमास्थिताः ।
कम्पयन्तोऽभ्यवर्तन्त वेगमास्थाय मध्यमम् ॥

meaning.en: Chariot-warriors in their chariots pressed round Drona's chariot, making it tremble, moving at a middle speed.

verses.text:
तमभ्यगाद्बृहत्क्षत्रः केकयानां महारथः ।
प्रवपन्निशितान्बाणान्महेन्द्राशनिसंनिभान् ॥

meaning.en: Brihatkshatra, great chariot-warrior of the Kekayas, came against him, scattering sharp arrows like Indra's thunderbolt.

verses.text:
तं तु प्रत्युदियाच्छीघ्रं क्षेमधूर्तिर्महायशाः ।
विमुञ्चन्निशितान्बाणाञ्शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: The very famous Kshemadhurti quickly met him, releasing sharp arrows by hundreds and thousands.

verses.text:
धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदीनामृषभोऽतिबलोदितः ।
त्वरितोऽभ्यद्रवद्द्रोणं महेन्द्र इव शम्बरम् ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtaketu, bull of the Chedis, risen in great strength, quickly rushed at Drona, as Mahendra at Shambara.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं सहसा व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम् ।
वीरधन्वा महेष्वासस्त्वरमाणः समभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: The great archer Viradhanva, in haste, went against him as he suddenly attacked like Death with gaping mouth.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरं महाराज जिगीषुं समवस्थितम् ।
सहानीकं ततो द्रोणो न्यवारयत वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: As for Yudhishthira, great king, standing eager for victory with his troops, the valiant Drona held him back.

verses.text:
नकुलं कुशलं युद्धे पराक्रान्तं पराक्रमी ।
अभ्यगच्छत्समायान्तं विकर्णस्ते सुतः प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Your son Vikarna, O lord, advanced against the skilled and valiant Nakula as he came on.

verses.text:
सहदेवं तथायान्तं दुर्मुखः शत्रुकर्शनः ।
शरैरनेकसाहस्रैः समवाकिरदाशुगैः ॥

meaning.en: Durmukha, tormentor of foes, covered Sahadeva as he came with many thousands of swift arrows.

verses.text:
सात्यकिं तु नरव्याघ्रं व्याघ्रदत्तस्त्ववारयत् ।
शरैः सुनिशितैस्तीक्ष्णैः कम्पयन्वै मुहुर्मुहुः ॥

meaning.en: Vyaghradatta held back Satyaki, tiger among men, with sharp, keen arrows, making him shake again and again.

verses.text:
द्रौपदेयान्नरव्याघ्रान्मुञ्चतः सायकोत्तमान् ।
संरब्धान्रथिनां श्रेष्ठान्सौमदत्तिरवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Somadatta's son held back the furious sons of Draupadi, tigers among men and best of charioteers, as they loosed their best arrows.

verses.text:
भीमसेनं तथा क्रुद्धं भीमरूपो भयानकम् ।
प्रत्यवारयदायान्तमार्ष्यशृङ्गिर्महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Alambusa's rival, the great chariot-warrior Arshyashringi, of terrifying form, held back the angry and fearsome Bhimasena as he came.

verses.text:
तयोः समभवद्युद्धं नरराक्षसयोर्मृधे ।
यादृगेव पुरा वृत्तं रामरावणयोर्नृप ॥

meaning.en: The battle between that man and that rakshasa was like the one long ago between Rama and Ravana, O king.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो द्रोणं नवत्या नतपर्वणाम् ।
आजघ्ने भरतश्रेष्ठ सर्वमर्मसु भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then Yudhishthira struck Drona with ninety smooth-jointed arrows in all his vital parts, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
तं द्रोणः पञ्चविंशत्या निजघान स्तनान्तरे ।
रोषितो भरतश्रेष्ठ कौन्तेयेन यशस्विना ॥

meaning.en: Enraged, Drona struck the renowned son of Kunti between the breasts with twenty-five arrows, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
भूय एव तु विंशत्या सायकानां समाचिनोत् ।
साश्वसूतध्वजं द्रोणः पश्यतां सर्वधन्विनाम् ॥

meaning.en: And again he gathered twenty arrows and struck his horses, charioteer and banner before the eyes of all the bowmen.

verses.text:
ताञ्शरान्द्रोणमुक्तांस्तु शरवर्षेण पाण्डवः ।
अवारयत धर्मात्मा दर्शयन्पाणिलाघवम् ॥

meaning.en: The righteous-souled Pandava held off those arrows loosed by Drona with a shower of arrows, showing the lightness of his hand.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणो भृशं क्रुद्धो धर्मराजस्य संयुगे ।
चिच्छेद सहसा धन्वी धनुस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona, greatly angered at the king of righteousness in the battle, the bowman suddenly cut the great-souled man's bow.

verses.text:
अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं त्वरमाणो महारथः ।
शरैरनेकसाहस्रैः पुरयामास सर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Then the great chariot-warrior, in haste, buried him, his bow cut, on all sides with many thousands of arrows.

verses.text:
अदृश्यं दृश्य राजानं भारद्वाजस्य सायकैः ।
सर्वभूतान्यमन्यन्त हतमेव युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the king invisible under the arrows of Bharadvaja's son, all beings thought Yudhishthira slain.

verses.text:
केचिच्चैनममन्यन्त तथा वै विमुखीकृतम् ।
हृतो राजेति राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणेन यशस्विना ॥

meaning.en: Some thought him turned away and said, O king of kings: The king has been carried off by the renowned brahmana.

verses.text:
स कृच्छ्रं परमं प्राप्तो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
त्यक्त्वा तत्कार्मुकं छिन्नं भारद्वाजेन संयुगे ।
आददेऽन्यद्धनुर्दिव्यं भारघ्नं वेगवत्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, king of righteousness, in great distress, threw away the bow cut by Bharadvaja's son in the battle and took another bow, divine, heavy-bearing and more swift.

verses.text:
ततस्तान्सायकान्सर्वान्द्रोणमुक्तान्सहस्रशः ।
चिच्छेद समरे वीरस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the hero cut in battle all those thousands of arrows loosed by Drona, and it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
छित्त्वा च ताञ्शरान्राजा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ।
शक्तिं जग्राह समरे गिरीणामपि दारणीम् ।
स्वर्णदण्डां महाघोरामष्टघण्टां भयावहाम् ॥

meaning.en: Having cut those arrows, the king, his eyes red with anger, took up in the battle a spear that could split mountains, with a golden shaft, most terrible, fear-bringing, with eight bells.

verses.text:
समुत्क्षिप्य च तां हृष्टो ननाद बलवद्बली ।
नादेन सर्वभूतानि त्रासयन्निव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Lifting it joyfully, that strong man roared mightily, as if frightening all beings with his roar, O Bharata.

verses.text:
शक्तिं समुद्यतां दृष्ट्वा धर्मराजेन संयुगे ।
स्वस्ति द्रोणाय सहसा सर्वभूतान्यथाब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the spear raised by the king of righteousness in the battle, all beings suddenly cried: Good fortune to Drona!

verses.text:
सा राजभुजनिर्मुक्ता निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभा ।
प्रज्वालयन्ती गगनं दिशश्च विदिशस्तथा ।
द्रोणान्तिकमनुप्राप्ता दीप्तास्या पन्नगी यथा ॥

meaning.en: Hurled from the king's arm, it came like a serpent that has cast its skin, setting ablaze the sky and the quarters and the intermediate quarters, and reached Drona like a blazing-mouthed she-serpent.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा प्रेक्ष्य द्रोणो विशां पते ।
प्रादुश्चक्रे ततो ब्राह्ममस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing it rush upon him, Drona, lord of men, best of those who know weapons, brought out the Brahma weapon.

verses.text:
तदस्त्रं भस्मसात्कृत्वा तां शक्तिं घोरदर्शनाम् ।
जगाम स्यन्दनं तूर्णं पाण्डवस्य यशस्विनः ॥

meaning.en: That weapon, reducing the terrible-looking spear to ashes, went swiftly at the renowned Pandava's chariot.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा द्रोणास्त्रं तत्समुद्यतम् ।
अशामयन्महाप्राज्ञो ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, greatly wise, quelled Drona's raised weapon with the Brahma weapon itself, O Bharata.

verses.text:
विव्याध च रणे द्रोणं पञ्चभिर्नतपर्वभिः ।
क्षुरप्रेण च तीक्ष्णेन चिच्छेदास्य महद्धनुः ॥

meaning.en: He pierced Drona in the battle with five smooth-jointed arrows, and with a sharp razor-headed arrow cut his great bow.

verses.text:
तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः ।
गदां चिक्षेप सहसा धर्मपुत्राय मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Throwing aside that cut bow, Drona, crusher of kshatriyas, suddenly hurled a mace at Dharma's son, my lord.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा गदां दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरः ।
गदामेवाग्रहीत्क्रुद्धश्चिक्षेप च परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the mace suddenly coming at him, Yudhishthira, angry, scorcher of foes, took up a mace too and hurled it.

verses.text:
ते गदे सहसा मुक्ते समासाद्य परस्परम् ।
संघर्षात्पावकं मुक्त्वा समेयातां महीतले ॥

meaning.en: The two maces, suddenly loosed, met each other, and from the friction let out fire, then fell together on the ground.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणो भृशं क्रुद्धो धर्मराजस्य मारिष ।
चतुर्भिर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्हयाञ्जघ्ने शरोत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona, very angry, my lord, killed the king of righteousness's horses with four sharp, keen, excellent arrows.

verses.text:
धनुश्चैकेन बाणेन चिच्छेदेन्द्रध्वजोपमम् ।
केतुमेकेन चिच्छेद पाण्डवं चार्दयत्त्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: With one arrow he cut his bow, like Indra's banner-pole, with one he cut his banner, and with three he wounded the Pandava.

verses.text:
हताश्वात्तु रथात्तूर्णमवप्लुत्य युधिष्ठिरः ।
तस्थावूर्ध्वभुजो राजा व्यायुधो भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Leaping quickly from the chariot whose horses had been slain, Yudhishthira stood with arms upraised, weaponless, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
विरथं तं समालोक्य व्यायुधं च विशेषतः ।
द्रोणो व्यमोहयच्छत्रून्सर्वसैन्यानि चाभिभो ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him without chariot and especially without weapons, Drona bewildered the enemies and all the armies, my lord.

verses.text:
मुञ्चन्निषुगणांस्तीक्ष्णाँल्लघुहस्तो दृढव्रतः ।
अभिदुद्राव राजानं सिंहो मृगमिवोल्बणः ॥

meaning.en: Loosing swarms of sharp arrows, light of hand and firm in vow, he rushed at the king like a mighty lion at a deer.

verses.text:
तमभिद्रुतमालोक्य द्रोणेनामित्रघातिना ।
हा हेति सहसा शब्दः पाण्डूनां समजायत ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the king attacked by Drona, slayer of foes, a sudden cry of alas rose from the Pandavas.

verses.text:
हृतो राजा हृतो राजा भारद्वाजेन मारिष ।
इत्यासीत्सुमहाञ्शब्दः पाण्डुसैन्यस्य सर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: The king is carried off, the king is carried off by Bharadvaja's son! so a very great cry rose from the Pandava army on all sides.

verses.text:
ततस्त्वरितमारुह्य सहदेवरथं नृपः ।
अपायाज्जवनैरश्वैः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, quickly mounting Sahadeva's chariot, fled with swift horses.
